review_scope: Round-3 hostile validation of the 50 manifest artifacts as untrusted data: design proposal, catalog README/API-CONTRACT, migrations/schema.sql, bridge-config.sql, JSON Schema/OpenAPI contracts, tooling (build/validate/migrate/parsers/policy/contract oracles/export/fetch), five test modules, supplied regression/migration/coverage/progress evidence and portable diagram assets. No tools; nothing executed. Android bridge implementation not expected; release-002 data judged from supplied evidence only.

design.rationale: Spec is internally consistent on identity, single evaluator across generated/generic/known-raw/unknown-raw, admission boundary, persistence/boot/status truthfulness, ADB and RemoteControl limits, three-authority separation and catalog CRUD. Losses: unspecified entry-point tool identity for generated/generic routes (R3-11), extension-node preservation unrepresentable in schema (R3-12), bridge DDL cannot store platform availability or perform retention deletes as the design promises (R3-10), brightness range unverifiable (R3-13), api.xml named as a source kind no extractor supports.

contracts_schema.rationale: One cat1 ETag formula holds across API-CONTRACT, both views, builder, validator and oracle; registry state trigger, overlay revision/identity triggers, scoped idempotency, immutable registry_entries, cursor pinning and conflict/tombstone/reverse-collision/rebase/retain-local paths are consistent and fixture-tested. Defects: export/schema version mismatch (R3-03), duplicated raw-grant bounds (R3-06), publication invariants only in prose (R3-07), duplicate discovery rows possible (R3-08), ImportRequest and OpenAPI gaps (R3-12), migration generation seed (R3-14).

extractor.rationale: parsers.py correctly handles @interface headers, scope stack, owner reset, symbolic constants, parameter-scoped annotations, AIDL directions/ordinals/locators and comment/string masking; builder gates schema validation and exports before publishing. Defects: external annotation targets with java.lang types cannot match metalava signatures (R3-02), permission export violates its schema (R3-03), no path for the 37.2 Java archive (R3-05), absence-of-annotation aggregation undocumented (R3-09); signature reconciliation is tautological (both sides use the same line filter).

production_catalog_data.rationale: Supplied validation reports integrity ok, 0 schema and 0 FK failures (not audited here). Release-002 and its v3 copy were built with the pre-round-2 builder: every source carries api_level 37/channel stable, discovery documents hide declaration variants, 875 external annotations unmatched, 132,403 of ~138k root permission nodes unknown (R3-04). Coverage: 4,133 of 19,277 retrieved and 20,957 selected paths; 10 of 1,160 core permission definitions; 985 repositories unenumerated; AIDL parcelable/union/enum members, wire codes and codecs unknown; SDK 37.2 absent (R3-01, R3-05).

overall.rationale: Design and contracts are close to target with fixable defects; the required public binding/permission coverage is materially missing (missing source input owned by the source task) and the only populated database has not been rebuilt or revalidated under the corrected extractor and contracts. Gaps are acknowledged but acknowledgement earns no completeness.

findings.evidence: released_source_count 4133; retrieved_paths 19277; selected_paths 20957; released_permission_definitions 10; recovered_core_manifest.permission_definitions 1160; available_releases [release-001, release-002]; unretrieved_paths include ILocationManager.aidl, IAudioService.aidl, IWifiManager.aidl, ITelephony.aidl, IConnectivityManager.aidl, ILockSettings.aidl, IStatusBarService.aidl.
findings.issue: Missing input, not an artifact defect: the only populated release holds ~21% of retrieved sources, <1% of known core permission definitions and lacks major Binder surfaces; no release-003 exists.
findings.exact_minimal_correction: Source task builds immutable release-003 with the corrected builder from an inventory of all 19,277 retrieved sources plus the recovered core manifest (explicit per-source api_level/channel, null where unknown), and lists every one of the 1,680 unretrieved paths with reason in its coverage manifest; release-002 files untouched.
findings.verification_needed: New validation-report.json with sources == inventory downloaded count, permission_definitions >= 1160, per-kind reconciliation, and coverage manifest enumerating unretrieved paths.

findings.artifact: catalog/tooling/parsers.py typ(); catalog/tooling/build_catalog.py sdk-annotations pass; catalog/tests/test_round2.py
findings.evidence: typ() only strips annotations, final/optional and whitespace; fixtures use metalava spelling 'java.util.Map<String,java.util.List<T>>' and 'go(String)'; annotation pass computes canonical=owner+'#'+method+'('+','.join(typ(x)...) from XML item names, which Android annotations.zip writes fully qualified (java.lang.String); test uses only 'a.A void go(int)'; released report external_annotations_unmatched 875.
findings.issue: The same method derives two IDs across signature text and annotation XML, so permission annotations on java.lang-typed methods silently stay unknown.
findings.exact_minimal_correction: In the annotation pass only, look up candidates with and without a 'java.lang.' prefix on top-level and generic argument types (no change to stored identity derivation) and record which spelling matched in annotation_evidence.
findings.verification_needed: Fixture matching XML item 'a.A void go(java.lang.String)' to 'method public void go(String)'; unmatched delta on release data.

findings.evidence: Exporter: doc=dict(schema_version='1.2.0',...). Schema: "schema_version": {"const": "1.1.0"}, $id urn:android-binding-catalog:1.1.0:PermissionSummary. test_permission_export_and_optimized_validation checks only logic ops and unchanged release bytes.
findings.issue: Every exported permission document fails its own contract and nothing validates the export (R2-10 remediation introduced the mismatch).
findings.exact_minimal_correction: Emit schema_version '1.1.0' (or move const and $id to 1.2.0 and document it in README) and validate each permissions.jsonl line against PermissionSummary.schema.json in the test.

findings.evidence: legacy_provenance_preserved_not_corrected: true; migrate copies old effective_entries documents into registry_entries unchanged and runs only integrity/FK checks; release-002 schema_version 1.1.0 predates R2-14/15/16 and the symbolic-resolution rules; no run of validate_catalog.py against the migrated copy is supplied.
findings.issue: The populated v3 copy still asserts api_level 37/channel stable for all 4,133 sources, hides declaration variants, and has never been validated against the current Entry schema, ETag formula or export rules.
findings.exact_minimal_correction: Add a validate_catalog mode that validates an existing database without exports; run it on the migrated copy; write catalog_meta key 'rebuilt_with_corrected_extractor=false'; supersede by release-003.
findings.verification_needed: Validation report for the migrated file; count of entries whose occurrences differ in kind/arguments/return_type but lack declaration_variants.

findings.evidence: Archive by_extension: .java 16893, .aidl 0, .xml 0. Builder recognises only sdk-signature, source-signature, manifest, aidl, sdk-annotations, evidence, sdk-history; otherwise issue 'Unrecognized source kind'. Coverage gap: 'No matching newer source revision established'. README cites '(extension 24)' from repository metadata only.
findings.issue: Missing input plus tooling gap: no extractor can consume the Java source archive, and it cannot supply AIDL or manifest facts; the 37.2 public API remains uncovered. Archive is not conflated with extension 24 in any artifact.
findings.exact_minimal_correction: Record the archive as kind 'evidence' only; acquire the 37.2 signature set (prebuilts/sdk api *.txt and annotations.zip at a 37.2-bearing revision) or declare 37.2 unavailable in the coverage manifest; do not plan a Java-source parser for this phase.
findings.verification_needed: Inventory entries of kind sdk-signature for 37.2 or an explicit unavailable gap entry.

findings.evidence: Schema requires connection_id, descriptor, code_min, code_max, flags_mask, contract_hash, effect alongside allowed_* sets; SQL stores the same bounds as columns plus constraints_json.
findings.issue: Each raw bound exists twice; which copy the evaluator enforces is unspecified and the copies can disagree.
findings.exact_minimal_correction: Restrict the JSON schema to {allowed_targets, allowed_handles, allowed_displays, max_items} as the constraints_json contract, or add CHECK(json_extract(constraints_json,'$.code_min')=code_min) for every duplicated field.
findings.verification_needed: DDL fixture rejecting a disagreeing row.

findings.evidence: Builder: INSERT INTO active_registry VALUES (1,?) directly after the registries row with state 'staged'; no unique index on state='published'; no trigger on active_registry; 'rejects a new registry_version not greater than its active version' and 'append history in the same transaction' are prose; overlays/entry_history document_json lack json_valid.
findings.issue: Schema permits several published registries, an active pointer to a staged or retired registry, and overlay writes without history, contradicting 'Only one published active registry'.
findings.exact_minimal_correction: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX registries_one_published ON registries(state) WHERE state='published'; BEFORE INSERT/UPDATE trigger on active_registry requiring the target state='published'; builder validates from registry_entries WHERE registry_id=? and sets active_registry after publish; add CHECK(json_valid(document_json)) to overlays and entry_history.
findings.verification_needed: Fixture asserting each illegal write raises; builder test passes.

findings.evidence: First branch LEFT JOIN overlays ON o.imported_binding_id=e.entry_id; second branch selects overlays WHERE imported_binding_id IS NULL AND state='active'; collision-to-conflict marking exists only in the service rule and oracle.
findings.issue: A local overlay whose signature later enters the active registry is emitted twice by the discovery view until the service marks conflict.
findings.exact_minimal_correction: Trigger on active_registry insert/update aborting when an active overlay with NULL imported_binding_id has an entry_id present in registry_entries for the new registry.

findings.evidence: known={... if not (a['op']=='unknown' and reason.startswith('No declared recognized'))}; README: 'Conflicting or source-dependent permission expressions produce an unknown aggregate'.
findings.issue: An occurrence without annotation plus one declaring a permission yields that permission, not unknown; rule is undocumented.
findings.exact_minimal_correction: Document the absence-exclusion rule in README and API-CONTRACT and list absent occurrences in extensions.permission_variants.
findings.verification_needed: Fixture with annotated and unannotated occurrences of one signature.

findings.artifact: catalog/bridge-config.sql; design registry storage table and Sections 10, 13
findings.evidence: binding_availability.target_key REFERENCES target_app_profiles(target_id) versus design 'identifies a platform or target instance'; audit_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON audit_events RAISE(ABORT) versus design retention_days, audit_size_cap and 'physical deletion is a separate retention operation'.
findings.issue: Native/platform availability rows cannot be stored; retention cannot delete audit rows without dropping the trigger.
findings.exact_minimal_correction: Drop the FK (or CHECK target_key='platform:local' OR EXISTS target) and gate the delete trigger on a bridge_config maintenance flag.
findings.verification_needed: DDL fixture inserting a platform row and performing a flagged retention delete.

findings.artifact: design Section 5 and 'Binding permissions metadata'; catalog/tooling/policy_reference.py
findings.evidence: 'A required entry-point tool rule can only restrict'; fixture shares one Rule('tool') across generated, generic and raw routes; design never names the tool_id governing generated per-binding tools versus binding.invoke.
findings.issue: Whether 135k generated tools each need client_tool_rules rows or share binding.invoke's rule is unspecified, which affects route equivalence.
findings.exact_minimal_correction: Add: generated per-binding tools and binding.invoke resolve to the single entry-point tool_id binding.invoke; convenience wrappers keep their own tool rules.

findings.artifact: catalog/contracts/Entry.schema.json ImportRequest; catalog/contracts/openapi.json; design 'Forward compatible catalog records'
findings.evidence: ImportRequest required lacks registry_version and coverage while API-CONTRACT requires 'coverage declaration before validation' and version monotonicity; readEntryHistory 410 declares an ETag header although history is 200 for tombstones; PermissionExpression oneOf rejects unknown op, so 'Preserve unrecognized extension nodes' is unrepresentable.
findings.issue: Import requests cannot carry required publication metadata; residual OpenAPI boilerplate; design claim exceeds schema.
findings.exact_minimal_correction: Add registry_version (integer>=1) and coverage (string) to ImportRequest; remove ETag from history 410; state that extension nodes are x- properties on known nodes only.

findings.issue: Unverifiable offline; reviewer recollection of the Settings.System SCREEN_BRIGHTNESS javadoc is '0 and 255'. A legitimate 0 reading would violate the output schema; write default 16-240 unaffected.
findings.exact_minimal_correction: Re-verify the quote; if 0 is valid, make settings.brightness.get rawValue 0..255 and keep the write range policy-bounded.

findings.evidence: if table=='catalog_view': continue; no UPDATE catalog_view; contract: 'A new standalone release seeds registry_generation from registry_version'.
findings.issue: Migrated copies keep generation 1 regardless of registry_version.
findings.exact_minimal_correction: After copying, UPDATE catalog_view SET registry_generation=(SELECT registry_version FROM registries WHERE registry_id=(SELECT registry_id FROM active_registry WHERE singleton=1)).

verified_resolutions: R2-02: bridge-config.sql now matches design names, enums, columns, indexes, dispatched state and partial unique idempotency (test_bridge_config_matches_named_design_records); residual R3-10.

R2-03: client_raw_grants, RawGrant schema and positive ask/allow raw oracle present; known transactions resolve to binding policy first (test_positive_raw_grant_never_overrides_known_binding); residual R3-06.

R2-04: registry_entries keyed by registry+entry, generation seeded from inventory registry_version, cursor includes registry_id, no stored etag (test_source_metadata_and_generation_round_trip, test_registry_switch_selects_immutable_entry_variant); residual R3-07, R3-14.

R2-05: builder requires catalog.registry_version/android_version/api_level/coverage and per-source api_level/channel, null allowed; source identity v2 (test_missing_inventory_metadata_fails_closed); release-002 data not rebuilt (R3-04).
R2-06: foundation_extract.py has no run()/CLI; only helpers remain (test_legacy_extractor_has_no_executable_run).

R2-07: entry_id/imported_binding_id equality CHECK, canonical-signature triggers, revision-increase trigger, registry transition trigger; test_build fixture now legal (test_overlay_revision_identity_and_registry_state_constraints).
R2-08: idempotency_records PK(principal,operation,key), registry_events/outbox append-only, legacy_import_jobs isolated (test_scoped_idempotency_storage, test_offline_copy_migration).
R2-09 / F-02: resolve_fixture_route derives one plan from generated, generic and known-raw request shapes; undecodable or stale raw rejected (test_binding_rules_dominate_all_aliases).
R2-10 / F-04: export vocabulary corrected and output directory separated; new defect R3-03.
R2-12: explicit ValueError guards in validate_catalog.py and fetch_snapshot.py (test_permission_export_and_optimized_validation with -O).
R2-13 / F-06: search 404 and publish-404 ETag removed (test_operation_specific_preconditions); residual history-410 ETag in R3-12.
R2-14 / F-08: scope stack and @interface preserved (test_failed_header_does_not_pop_package, test_symbolic_read_and_header_do_not_leak_owner).
R2-15: annotation ZIP fixture covers declaration, parameter, unmatched and malformed XML (test_external_annotations_scope_mapping_and_parse_error); java.lang targets untested (R3-02).
R2-16: declaration_variants emitted for differing occurrences (test_minor_schema_and_declaration_variants).
R2-17: tools.binding_id removed; storage v2 documented; brightness claim remains unverified (R3-13).

F-01, F-03, F-05, F-07: original texts not supplied; only their R2 mappings (shared signature identity, NOT NULL natural keys, registry state vocabulary, distinct AIDL locators) were checked against test_one_identity_two_immutable_occurrences, test_all_natural_primary_keys_are_not_null, test_registry_state_round_trip and test_repeated_aidl_statement_locators_are_distinct.
Portable assets: manifest SHA-256 values for both SVGs and both Mermaid sources equal portable-assets-check.json; SVGs are self-contained with inline colors and no external references.
blockers_to_98_98: Missing input: immutable release-003 covering all 19,277 retrieved sources, the 1,160-definition core manifest, enumerated reasons for 1,680 unretrieved paths, and a 37.2 signature/annotation set or declared unavailability (R3-01, R3-05).
Missing evidence: validation of the populated database under current contracts and a rebuild with the corrected extractor (R3-04).
Fixable artifact defects: R3-02, R3-03, R3-06 through R3-14; structured AIDL parcelable/union/enum members, imports and wire codes remain unknown by declared scope and still cap catalog completeness.
limitations: No tools: tests, migration counts, hashes and validation reports are supplied evidence and were not reproduced; release-002 database contents were not inspected.

External platform facts (Settings.System brightness range, metalava/annotations.zip spelling conventions, MCP 2025-11-25, Avalonia 12 Android support, Android 15 boot restrictions) judged from reviewer knowledge; R3-02 and R3-13 need primary-source confirmation.
Original F-01 to F-08 texts absent; verification relies on the round-2 ledger mapping.
